THE EXPERIENCE

Calm guidance, intentional photographs, and room for your story to unfold naturally.

CHAPTER 01
Baby-first sessions

Newborn photography at Doll Pictures is paced for your baby — warm rooms, soft setups and breaks whenever they need them. We never rush a pose or force a look.

Parents stay close throughout. We guide gentle posing and wrap styles so every frame feels natural, tender and true to your family.

CHAPTER 02
Themes, styling and delivery

Choose from custom studio themes or a simple, timeless look. We help with colour palettes and props that suit newborns, then edit with a soft cinematic finish.

Session length, image counts and album options depend on the package you select. We share a clear timeline at booking after your free consultation.

CHAPTER 03
Studio in Erode, families across Tamil Nadu

Most newborn sessions happen in our Erode studio at URT TOWERS, Teachers Colony, Palayapalayam. Families also travel to us from Salem, Namakkal, Coimbatore, Chennai and elsewhere in Tamil Nadu.

If a home or hospital-adjacent session is important for your baby, tell us during consultation so we can advise what is practical and comfortable.

CHAPTER 01
Cinematic coverage for your day

Doll Pictures by Ramya Vignesh approaches every wedding as a visual story. We blend candid emotion with crafted portraits so your gallery feels like a film you can revisit for years.

Whether you are planning an intimate ceremony or a multi-day celebration, we plan coverage around your rituals, family moments and the quiet in-between frames that make the day yours.

CHAPTER 02
What a wedding day with us feels like

Before the wedding we meet for a free consultation to understand your timeline, venues, preferred look and must-have moments. On the day, our team moves with the energy of the celebration — unobtrusive during rituals, intentional for portraits.

After delivery, you receive a curated preview followed by the full gallery and album options discussed at booking. Exact inclusions and turnaround are confirmed when you choose your package.

CHAPTER 03
Erode studio, Tamil Nadu travel

Our studio is based at URT TOWERS on Perundurai Road in Erode. We regularly photograph weddings across Tamil Nadu, including Salem, Namakkal, Coimbatore and Chennai, and can arrange destination coverage during consultation.

Share your venues and dates early so we can plan travel, second shooters if needed, and a timeline that protects both rituals and portraits.

Every wedding package lists clear inclusions so you know what coverage, albums and films are included before you book. We plan timelines around your rituals, family moments and the quiet frames that make the day yours.

Frequently asked questions
What is included in a wedding package?

Each package below lists its inclusions — such as traditional and candid photo/video, albums and outdoor sessions. Exact deliverables are confirmed when you book.

Do you photograph weddings outside Erode?

Yes. We are based in Erode and shoot weddings across Tamil Nadu. Destination celebrations can be arranged during consultation; travel fees are confirmed at booking.

Is the first consultation free?

Yes. Your first consultation is free so we can discuss story, look, budget and logistics before you commit.

Can I customise a package?

Yes. Many couples start from a listed package and adjust coverage hours, albums or film options. Share what you need when you enquire.

Ready to choose a package?

Enquire on a package above or book a free consultation — we will confirm inclusions and availability for your date.
